topology.realization: logical traffic pattern on the fat-tree fabric (A-UET1-FABRIC); NOT a physical ring

translation_assumptions.anchor: src/essun/backends/analytical/l0.py (ring_traffic_per_rank); src/essun/observables.py (O-CONSERVATION, O-TRAFFIC-IMBALANCE); runbook section 4.1 grammar
translation_assumptions.rationale: htsim_uec has no collective semantics, so the W1 AllReduce is translated as the chunked-ring WIRE pattern the L0 ring identity declares (l0.py ring_traffic_per_rank; O-CONSERVATION identity total 2*(r-1)*M; O-TRAFFIC-IMBALANCE relation 'each rank sends 2*(r-1)/r*M to its single successor'). The emitted traffic is therefore byte-identical to the L0/ASTRA-sim declared logical pattern; only its transport is simulated. Equal-chunk realizability requires r | M, mirroring the L0 divisibility gate A-L0-DIV.
translation_assumptions.value: one flow per rank per op: rank i -> ring successor (i+1) mod r, size 2*(r-1)/r*M bytes, requires r | M

translation_assumptions.anchor: runbook section 4.1 (connection_matrix.cpp grammar: src->dst [start] [size] [id] [msg] [trigger], no deps); src/essun/backends/astra_sim/adapter.py A-AS1-CHAIN
translation_assumptions.rationale: The connection-matrix grammar has no dependency mechanism (only absolute start times), so serialized ops — the L0 sum-of-ops reading and the ASTRA-sim data_deps chain (A-AS1-CHAIN) — cannot be expressed inside one file. Each op is compiled to its own matrix; op serialization is enforced by the stage S2 run orchestration (files run in op order, per-op completion times summed), never by invented start times. Within one op the r ring flows are concurrent (the wire pattern of one collective).
translation_assumptions.value: one .cm file per workload op; an op's r flows start at 0

translation_assumptions.rationale: With no -topo, the binary builds a fat tree sized by the matrix's Nodes header; the only smoke-verified shape is Nodes 16 (NSRV=16, runbook sections 4.1/4.3), so every compiled matrix declares exactly that and places ranks 0..r-1 on hosts 0..r-1 (hosts r..15 idle). The manifest's unidirectional ring is thus a LOGICAL traffic pattern on a fat-tree fabric: ring neighbors are multiple physical hops apart and each hop carries L (A-UET1-LAT), a declared modeling-assumption difference vs the single-hop L0/ASTRA ring — classified, never tuned, in the stage S3 independence note. Larger node counts are an untranslated gap pending -topo verification (runbook section 4.2, not exercised).
translation_assumptions.value: auto 3-tier fat tree, Nodes 16, ranks 0..r-1 placed

translation_assumptions.rationale: The flag is link speed in Mbps (runbook section 3); 1 B/ns = 1e9 B/s = 8000 Mbit/s exactly, so B = 64 B/ns maps to -linkspeed 512000. A bandwidth with no exact integral Mbps value (e.g. 1/3 B/ns) is rejected rather than silently rounded — the translation must not perturb the free parameter.

The flag is per-hop wire latency in us (runbook section 3); L = 200 ns maps to -hop_latency 0.2 exactly. A latency whose us form has no finite decimal is rejected, not rounded. NOTE the semantic difference: the flag applies per PHYSICAL fat-tree hop (see A-UET1-FABRIC), while L0 charges L once per logical ring hop — part of the declared cross-backend difference, not a conversion error.

Platform determinism rule 6 / runbook section 6: pass -seed explicitly instead of relying on the upstream default 13 (the two default-seed smoke runs were byte-identical, consistent with a fixed default). The manifest seed must fit the flag's uint range; out-of-range seeds are rejected.
Flow id 0 is rejected by the parser (runbook section 4.1), so ids start at 1; the rule is globally unique across all op files (op 0 -> 1..r, op k -> k*r+1..(k+1)*r) and replayable.

Upstream default packet size (HOST MTU, main.h:9 at the pin), retained. Packetization is a real effect this backend models and the L0 model does not — a declared fidelity difference, never tuned to match curves.

Upstream defaults, retained: they select the UET CMS path (NSCC sender congestion control with receiver credit) that is this backend's entire reason to exist in OD-002. Per the pin doc these are the WG research implementation's semantics, not the CMS specification.

Upstream default simulation end (us), retained. Static sufficiency estimate for the smoke shape (an ESTIMATE, not a result): 28672 B per flow at B = 64 B/ns serializes in 448 ns = 0.448 us, and the fat-tree path latency is a handful of 0.2 us hops, so per-op completion is far below 1000 us; stage S2 verifies against parsed output before relying on it.

workload.flow_rule: rank i -> (i+1) mod r, start 0, size 2*(r-1)/r*M (A-UET1-WIRE)
